title: Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
title_zh: 频率步缓存：分离同步与修复，实现高效的自回归视频扩散

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation makes long-horizon visual synthesis possible, but every generated chunk requires repeated forward passes through a large diffusion transformer (DiT). Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation. However, existing cache controllers often couple two decisions: when the cache is synchronized exactly and how much approximate computation is spent in between. Our characterization suggests that these decisions should be separated. For reactive staleness signals, exact synchronization should be scheduled before measured drift accumulates, while measured drift should decide only how much repair to spend between synchronizations. Based on this separation, we introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC) , a training-free controller that performs exact synchronization at full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse schedule and adaptive repair between them. A lightweight latent-space risk combining frequency-resolved drift with token age routes each non-anchor step from whole-step replay to selective token repair or full repair without changing the synchronization schedule. We further show on SkyReels-V2 that whole-step reuse provides the main acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. In a controlled ablation, using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the separation advantage also observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple AR video backbones, FSC provides favorable speed–quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches a 2.36 × 2.36\times speedup, above MotionCache’s 2.275 × 2.275\times , while improving SSIM by 0.019 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 0.5 dB. At MotionCache’s speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 1.0 dB, while lowering LPIPS by 0.024 0.024 . Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to the 14B SkyReels-V2 model at 2.12 × 2.12\times speedup, compared with 1.79 × 1.79\times for MotionCache.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频生成使得长时程的视觉合成成为可能，但每个生成的片段都需要对大型扩散变换器（DiT）进行重复的前向传播。 无需训练的缓存机制通过复用中间计算来降低这一成本。 然而，现有的缓存控制器通常将两个决策耦合在一起：何时精确同步缓存，以及两次同步之间应投入多少近似计算。 我们的分析表明，这两个决策应当被分离。 对于反应式陈旧信号，应在测量到的漂移累积之前安排精确同步，而测量到的漂移则应仅用于决定两次同步之间需要投入多少修复计算。 基于这种分离，我们提出了频率步缓存（FSC）——一种无需训练的控制器，它按照从密集到稀疏的调度在完整计算的锚点处执行精确同步，并在锚点之间进行自适应修复。 一种轻量级的潜在空间风险评估方法将频率分解的漂移与令牌年龄相结合，从而在每个非锚点步骤中，无需更改同步调度即可从全步骤重放到选择性令牌修复或完全修复。 我们进一步在 SkyReels-V2 上证明，全步骤复用提供了主要的加速效果，而选择性令牌计算作为保真度修复最为有效。 在一项受控的消融实验中，将同一个反应式信号同时用于同步和修复会降低匹配延迟下的保真度；在 FramePack 和 Matrix-Game 上也观察到了分离策略的优势。 在多种 AR 视频模型中，FSC 都能实现良好的速度–质量权衡。 在 SkyReels-V2 上，FSC-Speed 实现了 2.36 × 2.36\times 的加速，高于 MotionCache 的 2.275 × 2.275\times，同时将 SSIM 提升了 0.019 0.019，PSNR 提升了 0.5 0.5 dB。 在 MotionCache 的速度下，FSC-Quality 将 SSIM 提升了 0.031 0.031，PSNR 提升了 1.0 1.0 dB，同时将 LPIPS 降低了 0.024 0.024。 无需重新调优，FSC-Quality 可迁移至 14B SkyReels-V2 模型，实现 2.12 × 2.12\times 的加速，而 MotionCache 仅为 1.79 × 1.79\times。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation has emerged as a practical paradigm for long-horizon visual synthesis, generating videos sequentially by conditioning each new chunk on previously generated content ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Sand.ai et al., 2025 ) . This chunk-wise formulation makes long-video generation possible while keeping attention context and memory use bounded. However, each chunk still requires tens of denoising steps, which refine a noisy video representation through repeated evaluations of a large diffusion transformer ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) . Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate outputs across nearby steps ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Selvaraju et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . Yet redundancy varies across steps and video content, making it difficult to decide when reuse remains accurate ( Zou et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) . Reuse introduces approximation errors that can accumulate across steps and chunks ( Cui et al., 2026a ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Nan et al., 2026 ) . Existing cache controllers often use reactive reuse signals to govern both when exact computation occurs and how much approximation is allowed in between. These two roles operate differently: synchronization establishes the reference state for subsequent reuse, whereas repair responds to staleness observed after reuse. Cache control therefore involves two distinct decisions. (1) When should the cache be fully refreshed? We call this exact synchronization : full computation updates cached outputs and establishes a reference for measuring subsequent changes in the video representation. (2) How much should be recomputed between refreshes? We call this adaptive repair : choosing how much computation to perform based on observed changes that indicate inaccurate reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频生成已成为一种实用的长期视觉合成范式，它通过以先前生成的内容为条件来依次生成新的视频片段（Chen et al., 2024a; Yin et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025; Sand.ai et al., 2025）。 这种基于片段的构建方式使得长视频生成成为可能，同时保持了注意力上下文和内存使用的有限性。 然而，每个片段仍然需要数十步的去噪过程，这些过程通过反复评估大型扩散变换器来优化带有噪声的视频表示（Peebles and Xie, 2023）。 无需训练的缓存机制通过复用相邻步骤中的中间输出，降低了这一成本（Ma et al., 2024; Selvaraju et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025a）。 但冗余程度因步骤和视频内容的不同而有所差异，这使得判断何时复用仍然准确变得困难（Zou et al., 2025; Ma et al., 2026; Xu et al., 2026; Liu et al., 2025b）。 复用会引入近似误差，这些误差可能在不同步骤和片段之间累积（Cui et al., 2026a; Peng et al., 2026; Nan et al., 2026）。 现有的缓存控制器通常使用反应式的复用信号来管理精确计算的发生时机以及中间允许使用的近似程度。 这两种作用机制有所不同：同步为后续复用建立参考状态，而修复则响应在复用后观察到的过时信息。 因此，缓存控制涉及两个独立的决策。 (1) 何时应该对缓存进行完全刷新？ 我们称之为精确同步：完整的计算会更新缓存中的输出，并为衡量视频表示的后续变化建立参考基准。 (2) 在两次刷新之间应重新计算多少内容？ 我们称之为自适应修复：根据观察到的、表明复用不准确的变化，决定执行多少计算。

sents.zh: (1) 何时应该对缓存进行完全刷新？

sents.zh: 我们称之为精确同步：完整的计算会更新缓存中的输出，并为衡量视频表示的后续变化建立参考基准。

sents.zh: (2) 在两次刷新之间应重新计算多少内容？

sents.en: We call this adaptive repair : choosing how much computation to perform based on observed changes that indicate inaccurate reuse.
sents.zh: 我们称之为自适应修复：根据观察到的、表明复用不准确的变化，决定执行多少计算。

paragraphs.en: Our characterization motivates separating these decisions (Sec. 3 ). Reuse accuracy varies strongly by step, favoring scheduled synchronization (Fig. 1 (a)). Approximate synchronization leaves errors in the cached outputs reused by later steps, while change-based measurements report deviations only after they occur (Fig. 1 (d)). We therefore schedule exact synchronization independently of these measurements and use them only to allocate repair. In a controlled ablation, a purely reactive variant has lower fidelity at matched latency on all eight development prompts (Sec. 5.3 ). Between synchronizations, repair must balance accuracy against execution cost. On SkyReels-V2, selectively computing video tokens, the model’s units of video representation, yields much less speedup than the computation reduction suggests (Fig. 1 (c)). This favors reusing an entire step’s cached outputs for acceleration and selective computation for repair. To guide repair, a lightweight score based on changes in the video representation tracks reuse error. The score reaches a Spearman rank correlation of 0.893 0.893 with reuse error measured against full computation, as shown in Fig. 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的特征分析促使将这些决策分开处理（第 3 节）。 重用准确率在不同步骤间差异显著，因此更倾向于按计划进行同步（图 1 (a)）。 近似同步会在后续步骤重用的缓存输出中留下错误，而基于变化的测量方法则仅在偏差发生后才报告其偏离情况（图 1 (d)）。 因此，我们将精确同步与这些测量结果解耦地安排，仅使用它们来分配修复资源。 在一项受控的消融实验中，纯反应式变体在所有八个开发提示上，于匹配延迟下的保真度更低（第 5.3 节）。 在两次同步之间，修复必须在准确率与执行成本之间取得平衡。 在 SkyReels-V2 上，选择性地计算视频标记——即模型的视频表示单元——所带来的加速效果远小于计算量减少所预期的水平（图 1 (c)）。 因此，更倾向于重用整个步骤的缓存输出以实现加速，并通过选择性计算来进行修复。 为了指导修复过程，我们基于视频表示的变化设计了一个轻量级评分，用于跟踪重用错误。 该评分与通过完整计算测得的重用错误之间的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数达到 0.893（如图 3 所示）。

paragraphs.en: Guided by these findings, Frequency-Step Cache (FSC) schedules full-computation steps, called anchors , progressively farther apart (Sec. 4.1 ). Between anchors, it reuses cached outputs for a whole step or repairs them by recomputing varying numbers of tokens or performing full computation (Sec. 4.3 ). The repair score combines low- and high-frequency changes, representing coarse structure and fine detail respectively, with token age, the steps since each token’s last update (Sec. 4.2 ). These measurements control repair, never the anchor schedule. Our contributions are: (i) separating scheduled synchronization from measurement-driven repair, outperforming coupled control at approximately matched latency on SkyReels-V2, FramePack, and Matrix-Game; (ii) showing on SkyReels-V2 that whole-step reuse supplies acceleration while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair; and (iii) FSC, a training-free controller that combines scheduled exact anchors with lightweight frequency- and age-aware adaptive repair.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些发现，频率步缓存（FSC）安排全计算步骤（称为“锚点”）之间的间隔逐渐增大（第 4.1 节）。 在锚点之间，它会重用整个步骤的缓存输出，或通过重新计算不同数量的词元或执行完整计算来修复这些输出（第 4.3 节）。 修复分数结合了低频和高频变化——分别代表粗略结构和精细细节——以及词元年龄，即自每个词元上次更新以来的步骤数（第 4.2 节）。 这些测量值控制修复过程，但从不控制锚点的安排。 我们的贡献包括：(i) 将计划同步与基于测量的修复分离，在 SkyReels-V2、FramePack 和 Matrix-Game 上，在近似匹配的延迟下优于耦合控制；(ii) 在 SkyReels-V2 上证明，整个步骤的重用可提供加速效果，而选择性词元计算作为保真度修复最为有效；以及 (iii) FSC 是一种无需训练的控制器，它将计划的精确锚点与轻量级的、感知频率和年龄的自适应修复相结合。

sents.en: Guided by these findings, Frequency-Step Cache (FSC) schedules full-computation steps, called anchors , progressively farther apart (Sec. 4.1 ).

sents.en: Between anchors, it reuses cached outputs for a whole step or repairs them by recomputing varying numbers of tokens or performing full computation (Sec. 4.3 ).

sents.en: The repair score combines low- and high-frequency changes, representing coarse structure and fine detail respectively, with token age, the steps since each token’s last update (Sec. 4.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Experiments across multiple AR video backbones demonstrate favorable speed–quality trade-offs and consistently support the separation principle. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches a 2.36 × 2.36\times speedup, above MotionCache’s 2.275 × 2.275\times , while improving same-seed SSIM by 0.019 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 0.5 dB, with comparable VBench quality. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 0.031 , PSNR by 1.0 1.0 dB, and lowers LPIPS by 0.024 0.024 .
paragraphs.zh: 在多种 AR 视频基础模型上进行的实验表明，该方法在速度-质量权衡方面表现良好，并始终支持分离原则。 在 SkyReels-V2 上，FSC-Speed 实现了 2.36 × 2.36\times 的速度提升，高于 MotionCache 的 2.275 × 2.275\times，同时使相同种子的 SSIM 提升了 0.019 0.019，PSNR 提升了 0.5 0.5 dB，且 VBench 质量相当。 在与 MotionCache 匹配的速度下，FSC-Quality 将 SSIM 提升了 0.031 0.031，PSNR 提升了 1.0 1.0 dB，并将 LPIPS 降低了 0.024 0.024。

paragraphs.en: Recent AR video models generate long videos as sequences of causally conditioned frames or chunks with diffusion backbones ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , often trained with flow matching ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Sand.ai et al., 2025 ) . This chunk-wise formulation enables long-horizon generation under bounded context and memory, but each chunk still requires repeated denoising computation.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 AR 视频模型以扩散模型为基础，将长视频生成为由因果条件约束的帧或片段序列（Chen et al., 2024a; Yin et al., 2025），通常通过流匹配方法训练（Chen et al., 2025; Sand.ai et al., 2025）。 这种基于片段的生成方式使得在上下文和内存受限的情况下也能实现长时程生成，但每个片段仍需进行重复的去噪计算。

sents.en: Recent AR video models generate long videos as sequences of causally conditioned frames or chunks with diffusion backbones ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , often trained with flow matching ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Sand.ai et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 近期的 AR 视频模型以扩散模型为基础，将长视频生成为由因果条件约束的帧或片段序列（Chen et al., 2024a; Yin et al., 2025），通常通过流匹配方法训练（Chen et al., 2025; Sand.ai et al., 2025）。

sents.en: This chunk-wise formulation enables long-horizon generation under bounded context and memory, but each chunk still requires repeated denoising computation.
sents.zh: 这种基于片段的生成方式使得在上下文和内存受限的情况下也能实现长时程生成，但每个片段仍需进行重复的去噪计算。

paragraphs.en: Feature caching reduces repeated denoising computation by reusing activations or residuals across nearby steps, using fixed schedules (FORA ( Selvaraju et al., 2024 ) , Δ \Delta -DiT ( Chen et al., 2024b ) ), adaptive timing (TeaCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , DiCache ( Bu et al., 2026 ) ), or forecasting (TaylorSeer ( Liu et al., 2025c ) ). Token-wise methods instead combine reuse with selective recomputation: ToCa ( Zou et al., 2025 ) uses a predetermined refresh cycle with attention- and age-based token ranking, DuCa ( Zou et al., 2026 ) alternates reuse and token recomputation, and ProCache ( Cao et al., 2026 ) uses an offline-searched reuse schedule. ToCa studies token-wise caching in diffusion transformers but not chunk-autoregressive long-video cache control. It also fixes both the refresh cycle and token-recomputation budget a priori; attention and cache age rank which tokens receive that budget, whereas FSC adapts the repair amount online while keeping synchronization scheduled.
paragraphs.zh: 特征缓存通过在相邻步骤中重复利用激活值或残差，并使用固定时间表（FORA (Selvaraju et al., 2024)、Δ\Delta-DiT (Chen et al., 2024b)）、自适应定时（TeaCache (Liu et al., 2025a)、DiCache (Bu et al., 2026)）或预测方法（TaylorSeer (Liu et al., 2025c)），减少了重复的去噪计算。 相反，基于词元的策略将重复利用与选择性重新计算相结合：ToCa (Zou et al., 2025) 使用预定的刷新周期，并结合注意力机制和词元年龄进行排序；DuCa (Zou et al., 2026) 在重复利用和词元重新计算之间交替进行；而 ProCache (Cao et al., 2026) 则采用离线搜索的重复利用时间表。 ToCa 研究了扩散变换器中的基于词元的缓存，但并未涉及分块自回归长视频缓存控制。 该方法还预先固定了刷新周期和词元重新计算的预算；注意力机制和缓存年龄用于决定哪些词元获得该预算，而 FSC 则在线调整修复量，同时保持同步的定时安排。

paragraphs.en: FlowCache ( Ma et al., 2026 ) assigns chunk-level reuse policies, MotionCache ( Xu et al., 2026 ) introduces motion-aware token adaptivity, and ARCache ( Nan et al., 2026 ) determines whole-step reuse from history-token changes. SCOPE ( Cui et al., 2026b ) expands the inter-step action space through prediction and selective frame computation. These methods adapt reuse to temporal redundancy, but do not explicitly formulate exact-synchronization timing and intermediate repair amount as separate control decisions.
paragraphs.zh: FlowCache（Ma 等人，2026）分配了分块级重用策略，MotionCache（Xu 等人，2026）引入了运动感知令牌自适应机制，而 ARCache（Nan 等人，2026）则根据历史令牌的变化来确定整个步骤的重用。 SCOPE（Cui 等人，2026b）通过预测和选择性帧计算扩展了跨步骤的动作空间。 这些方法将重用机制与时间冗余进行了适配，但并未明确地将精确同步的时机和中间修复量作为独立的控制决策来制定。

sents.en: FlowCache ( Ma et al., 2026 ) assigns chunk-level reuse policies, MotionCache ( Xu et al., 2026 ) introduces motion-aware token adaptivity, and ARCache ( Nan et al., 2026 ) determines whole-step reuse from history-token changes.
sents.zh: FlowCache（Ma 等人，2026）分配了分块级重用策略，MotionCache（Xu 等人，2026）引入了运动感知令牌自适应机制，而 ARCache（Nan 等人，2026）则根据历史令牌的变化来确定整个步骤的重用。

sents.en: SCOPE ( Cui et al., 2026b ) expands the inter-step action space through prediction and selective frame computation.
sents.zh: SCOPE（Cui 等人，2026b）通过预测和选择性帧计算扩展了跨步骤的动作空间。

sents.en: These methods adapt reuse to temporal redundancy, but do not explicitly formulate exact-synchronization timing and intermediate repair amount as separate control decisions.
sents.zh: 这些方法将重用机制与时间冗余进行了适配，但并未明确地将精确同步的时机和中间修复量作为独立的控制决策来制定。

paragraphs.en: Frequency-aware methods use spectral information to schedule whole-step refreshes (SeaCache ( Chung et al., 2026 ) ) or manipulate frequency components (FreqCa ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , SpectralCache ( Li, 2026 ) ). PreciseCache ( Wang et al., 2026a ) uses low-frequency differences to decide when denoising computation can be skipped. FSC instead keeps exact synchronization timing independent of measured staleness: synchronization is scheduled, while frequency-resolved drift and cache age determine only inter-anchor repair.
paragraphs.zh: 频率感知方法利用频谱信息来安排整步刷新（SeaCache (Chung et al., 2026)）或操控频率分量（FreqCa (Liu et al., 2025b)、SpectralCache (Li, 2026)）。 PreciseCache (Wang et al., 2026a) 利用低频差异来决定何时可以跳过去噪计算。 FSC 则保持精确的同步时机与测得的陈旧性无关：同步是预先安排的，而频率分解的漂移和缓存年龄仅决定锚点间的修复。

sents.en: Frequency-aware methods use spectral information to schedule whole-step refreshes (SeaCache ( Chung et al., 2026 ) ) or manipulate frequency components (FreqCa ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , SpectralCache ( Li, 2026 ) ).

sents.en: FSC instead keeps exact synchronization timing independent of measured staleness: synchronization is scheduled, while frequency-resolved drift and cache age determine only inter-anchor repair.

paragraphs.en: We first characterize where redundancy exists and where naive caching fails in controlled profiling experiments (App. A.1 ). The resulting observations motivate the design; full-scale autoregressive ablations of the deployed controller (Sec. 5 ) reproduce the relevant orderings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先通过受控的配置文件实验（附录 A.1），明确冗余存在的位置以及简单缓存失效的位置。 由此得出的观察结果推动了该设计；对已部署控制器进行的全面自回归消融分析（第 5 节）重现了相关的顺序关系。

sents.en: We first characterize where redundancy exists and where naive caching fails in controlled profiling experiments (App. A.1 ).
sents.zh: 我们首先通过受控的配置文件实验（附录 A.1），明确冗余存在的位置以及简单缓存失效的位置。

sents.en: The resulting observations motivate the design; full-scale autoregressive ablations of the deployed controller (Sec. 5 ) reproduce the relevant orderings.
sents.zh: 由此得出的观察结果推动了该设计；对已部署控制器进行的全面自回归消融分析（第 5 节）重现了相关的顺序关系。

paragraphs.en: Reusing the previous step’s residuals at early steps incurs approximately 2.4 × 2.4\times the error of reuse at late steps (Fig. 1 (a)). Under a comparable anchor budget, dense-to-sparse placement yields the highest mean SSIM (Fig. 1 (b); Sec. 5.3 ). Design consequence: anchors should be dense early and increasingly sparse later (Sec. 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在早期步骤中重复使用上一步的残差，其误差约为晚期步骤重复使用误差的 2.4 × 2.4 倍（图 1 (a)）。 在锚点预算相当的情况下，从密集到稀疏的布局能产生最高的平均 SSIM（图 1 (b)；第 5.3 节）。 设计结论：锚点应在早期密集分布，并在后期逐渐稀疏（第 4.1 节）。

sents.en: Reusing the previous step’s residuals at early steps incurs approximately 2.4 × 2.4\times the error of reuse at late steps (Fig. 1 (a)).

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 (c) profiles true sparse kernels, which recompute a subset of tokens per step: at q = 0.10 q{=}0.10 they reach 1.94 × 1.94\times against a compute-proportional 2.72 × 2.72\times , mainly because full-context key/value handling and launch overhead do not shrink with token fraction. Their stale keys and values also cost ≈ 0.024 \approx 0.024 SSIM relative to a dense-forward token-refresh quality reference (its ≈ 1.23 × \approx 1.23\times is fixed by the full forward; App. A.3 ). Whole-step dense-to-sparse reuse reaches 2.62 × 2.62\times . FSC’s deployed token repair is a gathered-batch implementation whose cost is measured end to end. Design consequence: on this backbone, whole-step reuse should supply the acceleration, and token computation should primarily serve as fidelity repair (Sec. 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 1(c) 展示了真实的稀疏内核，该内核在每一步重新计算一部分令牌：当 q = 0.10 时，其计算量为 1.94 × 1.94，而按计算量比例计算的值为 2.72 × 2.72；这主要是因为完整上下文的键/值处理以及启动开销不会随着令牌比例的变化而减少。 它们的陈旧键和值相对于密集前向传播中的令牌刷新质量参考而言，还会造成约 0.024 SSIM 的损失（该参考的 1.23 倍计算量由完整的前向传播固定；见附录 A.3）。 整个步骤的密集到稀疏重用达到了 2.62 ×。 FSC 部署的令牌修复是一个批量收集实现，其成本是端到端测量的。 设计上的影响是：在此背骨架构上，整个步骤的重用应提供加速，而令牌计算则主要应作为保真度修复（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Only three of the 17 tested variants lie above the exact-anchor frontier (Fig. 1 (d); App. A.4 ). Any approximation inside an anchor is inherited by every step until the next anchor. Design consequence: anchors should remain exact full computations (Sec. 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在测试的 17 种变体中，只有三种位于精确锚点前沿之上（图 1(d)；附录 A.4）。 任何锚点内部的近似值都会一直保留到下一个锚点为止的每一步骤中。 设计影响：锚点应保持为精确的完整计算（第 4.1 节）。

sents.en: Design consequence: anchors should remain exact full computations (Sec. 4.1 ).
sents.zh: 设计影响：锚点应保持为精确的完整计算（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Between anchors, tokens go stale at different rates. High-frequency reuse error grows faster in absolute terms than low-frequency (LF) error. It remains about 2 2 – 2.5 × 2.5\times the LF error at cache ages 1–10, up to 2.7 × 2.7\times on individual prompts (Fig. 5 in App. A.5 ). Cache age complements drift: a token with small per-step drift can still become unreliable after many reuse steps. Design consequence: repair between anchors should follow measured staleness, proxied by frequency-resolved drift and cache age (Sec. 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在锚点之间，标记的失效速率各不相同。 高频重复使用的错误在绝对值上比低频（LF）错误增长得更快。 在缓存年龄为 1–10 时，该错误仍约为 LF 错误的 2.2 – 2.5 倍，在个别提示中最高可达 2.7 倍（见附录 A.5 中的图 5）。 缓存年龄与漂移相互补充：即使单个步骤的漂移很小，经过多次重复使用后，标记仍可能变得不可靠。 设计上的影响：锚点之间的修复应依据测得的失效程度进行，而该程度可通过频率分解的漂移和缓存年龄来近似表示（第 4.2 节）。

sents.zh: 在锚点之间，标记的失效速率各不相同。

sents.en: High-frequency reuse error grows faster in absolute terms than low-frequency (LF) error.
sents.zh: 高频重复使用的错误在绝对值上比低频（LF）错误增长得更快。

sents.en: It remains about 2 2 – 2.5 × 2.5\times the LF error at cache ages 1–10, up to 2.7 × 2.7\times on individual prompts (Fig. 5 in App. A.5 ).
sents.zh: 在缓存年龄为 1–10 时，该错误仍约为 LF 错误的 2.2 – 2.5 倍，在个别提示中最高可达 2.7 倍（见附录 A.5 中的图 5）。

sents.en: Cache age complements drift: a token with small per-step drift can still become unreliable after many reuse steps.
sents.zh: 缓存年龄与漂移相互补充：即使单个步骤的漂移很小，经过多次重复使用后，标记仍可能变得不可靠。

sents.en: Design consequence: repair between anchors should follow measured staleness, proxied by frequency-resolved drift and cache age (Sec. 4.2 ).
sents.zh: 设计上的影响：锚点之间的修复应依据测得的失效程度进行，而该程度可通过频率分解的漂移和缓存年龄来近似表示（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Because reactive signals report drift only after it occurs, these observations motivate the following control principle: schedule exact synchronization in advance (Obs. 1, 3), while using measured drift only to allocate inter-anchor repair (Obs. 2, 4).
paragraphs.zh: 由于反应性信号仅在漂移发生后才会报告，这些观察结果促成了以下控制原则：提前安排精确同步（观察 1、3），同时仅将测量到的漂移用于分配锚点间的修复任务（观察 2、4）。

paragraphs.en: FSC separates cache control into two decisions: exact synchronization determines when the cache is recomputed exactly, while adaptive repair determines how much residual computation is spent between synchronizations. Residual caching replays a transformer block’s stored residual instead of recomputing it.
paragraphs.zh: FSC 将缓存控制分为两个决策：精确同步决定何时对缓存进行精确重新计算，而自适应修复则决定两次同步之间需要消耗多少剩余计算资源。 剩余缓存机制会重放 Transformer 模块中存储的残差，而不是重新计算它。

sents.en: FSC separates cache control into two decisions: exact synchronization determines when the cache is recomputed exactly, while adaptive repair determines how much residual computation is spent between synchronizations.
sents.zh: FSC 将缓存控制分为两个决策：精确同步决定何时对缓存进行精确重新计算，而自适应修复则决定两次同步之间需要消耗多少剩余计算资源。

paragraphs.en: After the warmup, FSC recomputes all tokens in two situations that differ in timing. An anchor occurs at a step fixed before generation. At non-anchor steps, the staleness risk ρ s \rho_{s} (Sec. 4.2 ) may select a full repair . The risk may trigger a full repair but never removes or delays an anchor. FSC maintains two states. The residual cache state stores each token’s whole-stack residual, while keys and values are cached per block. The anchor latent reference 𝐗 ref \mathbf{X}_{\mathrm{ref}} holds the latent bands stored at the last anchor (Sec. 4.2 ). All drift is measured against it. An anchor replaces 𝐗 ref \mathbf{X}_{\mathrm{ref}} ; a full repair keeps it. Removing anchors and letting ρ s \rho_{s} trigger every full synchronization after warmup lowers fidelity (Sec. 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 热身阶段结束后，FSC 会在两种时间点上不同的情况下重新计算所有标记。 锚点出现在生成前一个固定步骤中。 在非锚点步骤中，陈旧风险 ρ s \rho_{s}（第 4.2 节）可能会选择完全修复。 该风险可能触发完全修复，但绝不会移除或延迟锚点。 FSC 维护两种状态。 剩余缓存状态存储每个标记的全栈残余，而键和值则按块缓存。 锚点潜在参考 𝐗 ref \mathbf{X}_{\mathrm{ref}} 保存了最后一个锚点处存储的潜在带（第 4.2 节）。 所有漂移都相对于它进行测量。 锚点会替换 𝐗 ref \mathbf{X}_{\mathrm{ref}}；完全修复则会保留它。 移除锚点并让 ρ s \rho_{s} 在热身阶段后触发每次完全同步，会降低保真度（第 5.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Each step makes up to three decisions (Fig. 2 ; Algorithm 1 in App. B.7 ). First, warmup steps and anchors compute all tokens exactly. Second, at any other step, ρ s \rho_{s} chooses how much to compute: replay ( C ​ 0 C0 ), token repair ( C ​ 1 C1 – C ​ 3 C3 ), or full repair. Third, if token repair is selected, accumulated drift and token age choose which tokens to recompute.

paragraphs.en: On MAGI-1, FSC scales the native token-level reuse threshold, forces exact computation at anchors, and fully recomputes every k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}} -th step (App. B.5 ). MAGI-1 therefore tests transfer through its native cache interface, not the frequency controller. The controller needs no auxiliary network and adds under 0.2 % 0.2\% latency (App. B.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 MAGI-1 中，FSC 调整了原生令牌级重用阈值，强制在锚点处进行精确计算，并在每个第 k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}} 步时完全重新计算（附录 B.5）。 因此，MAGI-1 通过其原生缓存接口而非频率控制器来测试迁移。 该控制器无需辅助网络，且增加的延迟低于 0.2 % 0.2\%（附录 B.6）。

paragraphs.en: SkyReels-V2, FramePack ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and Matrix-Game-3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026b ) use the full FSC controller, whereas MAGI-1 tests transfer through its native cache interface (Sec. 4.4 ). SkyReels-V2-1.3B ( Chen et al., 2025 ) generates 540P videos of 177 177 frames (two 97 97 -frame chunks with 17 17 overlapping frames, 50 50 steps per temporal group; App. D ). MAGI-1-4.5B-distill ( Sand.ai et al., 2025 ) generates 720 × 720 720\times 720 videos of 168 168 frames (seven 24 24 -frame chunks, 64 64 steps per chunk). We compare against vanilla, FlowCache ( Ma et al., 2026 ) with chunk-level reuse, MotionCache ( Xu et al., 2026 ) with token-level reuse in its released configuration, and our latency-calibrated SeaCache port. All share one stack, prompts, seed, checkpoints, and settings; SCOPE ( Cui et al., 2026b ) runs on its official stack. FlowCache runs with its KV-cache compression disabled. In a probe run, the official FlowCache stack without compression runs at 2.21 × 2.21\times , close to our reproduction ( 2.04 × 2.04\times ), at comparable fidelity (App. E ). We found no public implementation of ARCache ( Nan et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: SkyReels-V2、FramePack（Zhang 等人，2025）和 Matrix-Game-3.0（Wang 等人，2026b）使用了完整的 FSC 控制器，而 MAGI-1 则通过其原生缓存接口测试迁移能力（第 4.4 节）。 SkyReels-V2-1.3B（Chen 等人，2025）生成分辨率为 540P、包含 177 帧的视频（由两个各含 97 帧的片段组成，中间有 17 帧重叠，每个时间组包含 50 步；见附录 D）。 MAGI-1-4.5B-distill（Sand.ai 等人，2025）生成分辨率为 720×720、包含 168 帧的视频（由七个各含 24 帧的片段组成，每个片段包含 64 步）。 我们将模型与原始版本、支持片段级重用的 FlowCache（Ma 等人，2026）、在其发布配置中支持词元级重用的 MotionCache（Xu 等人，2026），以及我们经过延迟校准的 SeaCache 端口进行了比较。 所有模型共享同一个堆栈、提示词、种子值、检查点和设置；SCOPE（Cui 等人，2026b）则在其官方堆栈上运行。 FlowCache 在运行时禁用了其 KV 缓存压缩功能。 在一次探测运行中，未启用压缩的官方 FlowCache 堆栈的运行速度为 2.21×，接近我们复现的结果（2.04×），且保真度相当（见附录 E）。 我们未能找到 ARCache（Nan 等人，2026）的任何公开实现。

paragraphs.en: We report two operating points of the same controller. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Quality matches MotionCache’s latency and is the single configuration used for all SkyReels-V2 ablations, sensitivity and seed studies, and the 14B no-retuning transfer; FSC-Speed differs only in warmup length and threshold scale and is a faster point on the speed–quality frontier (App. E.1 ). On MAGI-1, both points are calibrated on its native cache interface and run faster than MotionCache. FramePack and Matrix-Game each use one per-backbone calibrated configuration (App. E.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了同一控制器的两个运行点。 在 SkyReels-V2 上，FSC-Quality 的延迟与 MotionCache 一致，并且是 SkyReels-V2 所有消融研究、敏感性和种子研究以及 14B 无重新调优迁移中使用的唯一配置；FSC-Speed 仅在预热时长和阈值尺度上有所不同，并且是速度–质量前沿上更快的一个点（附录 E.1）。 在 MAGI-1 上，这两个点均基于其原生缓存接口进行校准，且运行速度比 MotionCache 更快。 FramePack 和 Matrix-Game 各自使用一种针对每个主干网络校准的配置（附录 E.2）。

paragraphs.en: Quality is measured with VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) on a fixed dimension set chosen with reference to prior autoregressive video caching protocols ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , with the official normalization and weights (App. D ). Unless noted, all timings use one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU per video on otherwise idle devices. Fidelity is PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) against the same-seed vanilla output. VBench and same-seed fidelity are complementary: VBench measures reference-free video quality, whereas fidelity measures the approximation error that caching introduces relative to the unmodified generator. Same-seed fidelity requires vanilla references and is therefore evaluated on subsets. The evaluation sets are:
paragraphs.zh: 质量通过 VBench-Long（Huang 等，2024；Huang 等，2025）进行衡量，该测试基于参考先前自回归视频缓存协议（Ma 等，2026；Xu 等，2026）所选定的固定维度集，并使用官方归一化和权重（附录 D）。 除非另有说明，所有计时均使用每个视频一台 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU，其余设备保持空闲状态。 保真度指标包括 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018），并与相同种子的原始输出进行比较。 VBench 与相同种子保真度互为补充：VBench 衡量无需参考的视频质量，而保真度则衡量缓存相对于未修改生成器的近似误差。 相同种子保真度需要原始参考数据，因此仅在子集上进行评估。评估集如下：

paragraphs.en: On SkyReels-V2 (Table 1 ; FSC-Speed examples in Fig. 7 ), FSC-Quality matches MotionCache’s latency. It raises SSIM from 0.790 0.790 to 0.821 0.821 , improves PSNR by 1.04 1.04 dB, and lowers LPIPS by 0.024 0.024 ; all three paired 95% CIs exclude zero. FSC-Speed reaches 2.36 × 2.36\times , exceeding all shared-stack baselines while improving SSIM by 0.019 0.019 and PSNR by 0.53 0.53 dB over MotionCache, both with CIs excluding zero. At both operating points the VBench difference from MotionCache is not statistically resolved. This complements the fidelity result: the methods retain similar reference-free quality but differ in how strongly caching perturbs the same-seed trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SkyReels-V2（表 1；图 7 中的 FSC-Speed 示例）中，FSC-Quality 的延迟与 MotionCache 相当。 它将 SSIM 从 0.790 提升至 0.821，PSNR 提高了 1.04 dB，LPIPS 降低了 0.024；这三个配对 95% 置信区间均不包含零。 FSC-Speed 达到了 2.36 倍，超过了所有共享堆栈基线方法，同时相比 MotionCache，SSIM 提升了 0.019，PSNR 提高了 0.53 dB，且两者的置信区间均不包含零。 在这两个工作点上，VBench 与 MotionCache 的差异在统计上均未显著。 这一结果补充了保真度方面的发现：这些方法保持了类似的无参考质量，但在缓存对相同种子轨迹的扰动强度上存在差异。

paragraphs.en: The MotionCache threshold sweep confirms that its released τ = 0.10 \tau{=}0.10 is also its latency-matched operating point. On evaluation prompts outside the sweep set, FSC-Quality retains a + 0.049 +0.049 SSIM advantage at matched latency. At the same operating point, FSC-Quality also exceeds matched FlowCache and SeaCache-AR by 0.056 0.056 and 0.045 0.045 SSIM, respectively (Table 2 (a), Fig. 4 (a)). The concurrent SCOPE is faster in seconds but 0.015 0.015 lower on VBench than FSC-Quality (CI [ − 0.024 , − 0.006 ] [-0.024,-0.006] ); stack and fidelity comparability are detailed in App. E.6 .
paragraphs.zh: MotionCache 的阈值扫描证实，其释放的 τ = 0.10 \tau{=}0.10 同时也是其延迟匹配的运行点。 在扫描集之外的评估提示上，FSC-Quality 在匹配延迟下仍保持 +0.049 +0.049 的 SSIM 优势。 在同一运行点上，FSC-Quality 的 SSIM 也分别比匹配的 FlowCache 和 SeaCache-AR 高出 0.056 0.056 和 0.045 0.045（表 2(a)、图 4(a)）。 并行的 SCOPE 在秒数上更快，但在 VBench 上的得分比 FSC-Quality 低 0.015 0.015（CI [−0.024, −0.006] [-0.024,-0.006]）；堆栈和保真度的可比性详见附录 E.6。

paragraphs.en: FSC-Quality transfers unchanged to the ∼ 11 × {\sim}11\times larger SkyReels-V2 14B, reaching 2.12 × 2.12\times versus MotionCache’s 1.79 × 1.79\times with higher SSIM and PSNR, slightly higher LPIPS, and comparable VBench quality (Table 2 (b); App. E.9 ). On 1.3B, the fidelity gain replicates across five seeds (App. E.4 ). The advantage also grows with motion: across vanilla motion terciles, FSC-Quality’s SSIM margin over MotionCache increases from + 0.018 +0.018 at low motion to + 0.049 +0.049 at high motion, with the same trend in LPIPS.
paragraphs.zh: FSC-Quality 的性能无损地迁移到了尺寸约为 ∼11 × {\sim}11\times 更大的 SkyReels-V2 14B 模型上，其性能达到 2.12 × 2.12\times，高于 MotionCache 的 1.79 × 1.79\times，且 SSIM 和 PSNR 更高，LPIPS 略高，VBench 质量则相当（表 2 (b)；附录 E.9）。 在 1.3B 模型上，保真度提升的效果在五组随机种子中均得以重现（附录 E.4）。 随着运动量的增加，这种优势也会扩大：在常规运动量的三个分位数中，FSC-Quality 相对于 MotionCache 的 SSIM 差距从低运动量时的 +0.018 增加到了高运动量时的 +0.049，LPIPS 也呈现出相同趋势。

paragraphs.en: Removing the anchors and letting ρ s \rho_{s} trigger both repair and full synchronization gives a controlled purely reactive variant of FSC: it uses the same risk signal and repair machinery but has no scheduled anchors. At matched latency, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.131 0.131 and lowers LPIPS by 0.186 0.186 on all eight development prompts. Giving the reactive variant 13 % 13\% or 31 % 31\% more latency narrows but does not eliminate the SSIM gap (Fig. 4 (b); Table 3 ). This controlled result shows that, for FSC’s risk signal and repair mechanism, keeping exact synchronization scheduled is more effective than using the same reactive signal to determine both decisions. On the Cross set, FSC also outperforms a latency-matched purely reactive comparator on FramePack / Matrix-Game: SSIM + 0.079 +0.079 / + 0.058 +0.058 , PSNR + 5.18 +5.18 / + 2.77 +2.77 dB, and LPIPS − 0.092 -0.092 / − 0.057 -0.057 ; all 95% CIs exclude zero. These backbones differ from SkyReels-V2 in cache interface and token-execution cost, so the result supports the separation principle independently of SkyReels-specific sparse execution.
paragraphs.zh: 移除锚点，并让 ρ s \rho_{s} 同时触发修复和完整同步，可以得到一种受控的纯反应式 FSC 变体：它使用相同的风险信号和修复机制，但没有预定的锚点。 在匹配延迟的情况下，FSC-Quality 在所有八个开发提示上使 SSIM 提升了 0.131 0.131，并将 LPIPS 降低了 0.186 0.186。 为这种反应式变体提供 13 % 13\% 或 31 % 31\% 的额外延迟，虽然缩小了 SSIM 差距，但并未完全消除该差距（图 4 (b)；表 3）。 这一受控结果表明，对于 FSC 的风险信号和修复机制而言，保持精确同步的预定安排比使用相同的反应式信号来决定两种操作更为有效。 在 Cross 数据集上，FSC 在 FramePack / Matrix-Game 上也优于延迟匹配的纯反应式对比模型：SSIM +0.079 +0.079 / +0.058 +0.058，PSNR +5.18 +5.18 / +2.77 +2.77 dB，LPIPS −0.092 -0.092 / −0.057 -0.057；所有 95% 置信区间均不包含零。 这些骨干模型在缓存接口和令牌执行成本上与 SkyReels-V2 存在差异，因此该结果独立于 SkyReels 特定的稀疏执行特性，支持了分离原则。

paragraphs.en: A 2 × 2 2\times 2 factorial on the Dev set separates the two components: dense-to-sparse placement adds 0.017 0.017 SSIM without repair, adaptive repair adds 0.068 0.068 under uniform anchors, while combining both yields the largest gain of 0.088 0.088 . Cache age provides an important overdue safeguard: removing the age term and its overdue rule reduces SSIM by 0.021 0.021 on all eight prompts while lowering latency by 4 % 4\% . Around FSC-Quality, six of eight local perturbations change SSIM by ≤ 0.003 \leq 0.003 and latency by ≤ 1.8 % \leq 1.8\% .
paragraphs.zh: 在开发集上对 2×2 阶乘进行计算时，两种方法分别提升了两个组件：密集到稀疏的放置方式在未修复的情况下增加了 0.017 的 SSIM，自适应修复在均匀锚点下增加了 0.068，而结合两者则带来了最大的提升，达到 0.088。 两项结果支持公式 1 中差距不断扩大的趋势：单个缓存步骤对最终视频的影响从第 8 步到第 39 步衰减了 6.1 倍，并且所有端到端评估的替代调度方案（包括均匀调度、反向调度以及三种代理优化调度）都产生了更低的平均 SSIM（见表 3 和表 17）。 缓存年龄提供了一个重要的逾期保护机制：移除年龄项及其逾期规则后，在所有八个提示中 SSIM 下降了 0.021，同时延迟降低了 4%。 在 FSC-Quality 附近，八种局部扰动中有六种对 SSIM 的影响 ≤ 0.003，对延迟的影响 ≤ 1.8%。

paragraphs.en: Our results support one principle for cache control in AR video diffusion: for reactive staleness signals, exact synchronization should be scheduled before measured drift accumulates, and measured drift should only decide how much repair to spend between synchronizations. FSC instantiates this principle through scheduled exact anchors and whole-step replay, with a frequency- and age-aware latent risk controlling inter-anchor repair. On SkyReels-V2 (1.3B and, unchanged, 14B), FSC is closer to the vanilla trajectory than MotionCache in SSIM and PSNR at equal or higher speed, and coupling both decisions into one risk signal reduces fidelity at matched latency (Sec. 5.3 ). On MAGI-1, FSC’s native-interface port improves speed and fidelity over MotionCache at comparable VBench, and the separation advantage holds on FramePack and Matrix-Game with per-backbone calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果支持 AR 视频扩散中缓存控制的一项原则：对于反应式陈旧信号，应在测量到的漂移累积之前安排精确同步；而测量到的漂移仅应决定两次同步之间需要投入多少修复资源。 FSC 通过计划好的精确锚点和整步重播实现了这一原则，同时利用一种考虑了频率和年龄的潜在风险机制来控制锚点之间的修复操作。 在 SkyReels-V2（1.3B 以及未变更的 14B）上，当速度相等或更高时，FSC 在 SSIM 和 PSNR 指标上更接近原始轨迹，而非 MotionCache；而将两种决策耦合到单一风险信号中，则会在匹配的延迟下降低保真度（第 5.3 节）。 在 MAGI-1 上，FSC 的原生接口端口在 VBench 性能相当的情况下，比 MotionCache 实现了更高的速度和保真度；这种分离优势在 FramePack 和 Matrix-Game 上通过每骨干校准后依然成立。

paragraphs.en: Sec. 4 defines the FSC controller, including the dense-to-sparse anchor schedule, the frequency- and age-aware staleness risk, and the repair routing. Algorithm 1 (App. B.7 ) gives the per-step procedure, while App. B provides the exact schedule construction, routing rules, cache-state updates, and backbone-specific instantiations (App. B.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Along a full-compute trajectory, at every step s s and every transformer block we reuse that block’s residual from step s − 1 s-1 given the block’s exact input and measure the relative error against the exact output, so errors never compound; the curve averages these block-local errors over the 40 40 blocks and 6 6 prompts. “Early” and “late” in the 2.4 × 2.4\times ratio denote the mean error over the steps 1 1 – 10 10 and 40 40 – 49 49 of the 50 50 -step trajectory, respectively. The placement comparison (Fig. 1 (b)) compares three placements of exact refreshes: dense-to-sparse ( 7 7 refreshes, 2.62 × 2.62\times ; gaps increasing along the trajectory), uniform ( 8 8 refreshes, 2.49 × 2.49\times ; equal gaps), and sparse-to-dense ( 7 7 refreshes, 2.62 × 2.62\times ; the mirror image). Dense-to-sparse attains the highest mean SSIM, ahead of uniform on 6 6 of the 8 8 paired prompts (one tie) and of sparse-to-dense on 7 7 ; the full-controller schedule ablation on the development set is reported in Sec. 5.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在整个计算轨迹中，在每个步骤 s 和每个 Transformer 块中，我们基于该块的精确输入，复用其来自步骤 s−1 的残差，并测量其与精确输出的相对误差，从而确保误差不会累积；该曲线将这 40 个块和 6 个提示词上的块级局部误差进行平均。2.4 × 的比例中的“早期”和“晚期”分别表示 50 步轨迹中步骤 1–10 和 40–49 的平均误差。 布局对比（图 1(b)）比较了精确刷新操作的三种布局：密集转稀疏（7 次刷新，2.62 ×；间隙沿轨迹逐渐增大）、均匀布局（8 次刷新，2.49 ×；间隙相等）以及稀疏转密集（7 次刷新，2.62 ×；与密集转稀疏布局互为镜像）。 密集转稀疏布局实现了最高的平均 SSIM，在 8 个成对提示词中的 6 个上优于均匀布局（1 个并列），并在 7 个上优于稀疏转密集布局；开发集上的完整控制器调度消融分析见第 5.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Two prototypes (Fig. 1 (c)) are profiled at token fractions q ∈ { 0.10 , 0.15 , 0.20 , 0.30 } q\in\{0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\} (Table 4 ): a dense-forward token-refresh reference and true sparse kernels. Token refresh is a dense-forward quality reference: at every step between anchors it runs the full transformer forward for all tokens and keeps the fresh output only for the selected tokens (the others keep their cached output). Its speedup is therefore flat at 1.23 × 1.23\times by construction (only the last ten of the 50 50 steps are free whole-step copies) and does not measure the cost of sparse execution; the speed argument rests on the true sparse kernels. True sparse kernels execute attention and FFN only for the selected tokens; the kernel is exact for those tokens, but non-selected tokens contribute keys and values re-projected from their cached, stale hidden states. Its speedup rises to 1.94 × 1.94\times at q = 0.10 q=0.10 , still well below its own compute-proportional projection ( 2.72 × 2.72\times ), mainly because costs that do not shrink with q q remain, chiefly re-projecting the keys and values of the full context (the largest single item) and per-block launch overhead; the stale keys/values additionally incur an ≈ 0.024 \approx 0.024 SSIM reduction relative to the dense-forward token-refresh reference run on the same six-anchor schedule (a separate run from the three-anchor speed measurement of Table 4 ). Whole-step output reuse with dense-to-sparse refreshes, which skips the transformer entirely at reused steps, reaches 2.62 × 2.62\times under the same conditions. The deployed controller (Sec. 4.3 ) matches neither prototype exactly: repaired tokens run as a gathered batch through every layer and attend to the cached keys and values of all tokens without re-projecting them; its cost enters Sec. 5 only through measured end-to-end latency.
paragraphs.zh: 两种原型（图 1(c)）在令牌比例 q ∈ {0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30}（表 4）下进行了分析：一种密集前向的令牌刷新参考模型，以及真正的稀疏内核。 令牌刷新是一种密集前向的质量参考模型：在每个锚点之间的步骤中，它都会为所有令牌运行完整的前向变换器，并且仅保留所选令牌的更新输出（其他令牌则保留其缓存输出）。 因此，其加速比按设计固定为 1.23 倍（只有 50 个步骤中的最后十个是完整的自由步骤复制），且未衡量稀疏执行的成本；加速比的论证基于真正的稀疏内核。 真正的稀疏内核仅为所选令牌执行注意力和前馈神经网络（FFN）；对于这些令牌，该内核是精确的，而未选中的令牌则通过从其缓存的旧隐藏状态重新投影来贡献键和值。 在 q = 0.10 时，其加速比升至 1.94 倍，但仍远低于其自身的计算比例预测值（2.72 倍），这主要是因为不随 q 缩小的成本仍然存在，主要包括对整个上下文的键和值进行重新投影（这是最大的单一项）以及每个块的启动开销；此外，这些过时的键/值与在同一六个锚点调度下运行的密集前向令牌刷新参考模型相比，还会导致约 0.024 的 SSIM 下降（该参考模型是表 4 中三个锚点的加速测量之外的独立运行）。 在相同条件下，结合密集到稀疏刷新的完整步骤输出重用方法（在重用步骤中完全跳过变换器）可达 2.62 倍的加速比。 部署的控制器（第 4.3 节）与这两种原型都不完全一致：修复后的令牌作为一个聚合批次通过每一层运行，并关注所有令牌的缓存键和值而无需重新投影它们；其成本仅通过测量的端到端延迟体现在第 5 节中。

paragraphs.en: An anchor step is the reference that all following non-anchor steps replay from; any approximation inside it is inherited by every step until the next anchor. We tested 17 17 approximate-anchor policies grouped into three families: (i) pyramid kernels , which inside refresh steps reuse cached block residuals band by band when per-block gates on input drift, residual stability, and age allow it, and reconstruct skipped blocks from the cached bands ( pyramid-full is the complete kernel); (ii) block-skip gates at anchors , which skip transformer blocks whose input change falls below a threshold even during refresh steps; and (iii) adaptive anchor skipping, which skips a nominal anchor when the measured input risk is low and keeps the whole cache instead. Only three of these points lie above the clean-anchor Pareto frontier of Fig. 1 (d): block-skip gates at 3.01 3.01 – 3.04 × 3.04\times with identical SSIM ( 0.824 0.824 ), up to 0.008 0.008 above its linear interpolation and not dominated by any clean schedule. The pyramid-full variant has approximately 0.046 0.046 lower SSIM than the clean full-anchor baseline at the same nominal budget. Block-skip gates at anchors provide additional speedup ( 2.00 2.00 – 3.54 × 3.54\times vs. the clean full-anchor baseline’s 1.94 × 1.94\times ) at lower SSIM than the clean baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 锚点步是后续所有非锚点步重播的参考；其内部的任何近似值都会被每个步继承，直到遇到下一个锚点。 我们测试了 17 种近似锚点策略，分为三类：(i) 金字塔核，在刷新步中，当输入、残差稳定性及年龄相关的每块门限允许时，按频段复用缓存的块残差，并从缓存频段重建跳过的块（pyramid-full 是完整的核）；(ii) 锚点处的块跳过门限，在刷新步中也会跳过输入变化低于阈值 Transformer 块；以及 (iii) 自适应锚点跳过，当测得的输入风险较低时跳过名义锚点，并保留整个缓存。 这些策略中只有三种位于图 1(d) 中干净锚点帕累托前沿之上：块跳过门限在 3.01–3.04× 且 SSIM 相同（0.824），最高比其线性插值高 0.008，且不被任何干净调度所支配。 在相同的名义预算下，pyramid-full 变体的 SSIM 比干净的完整锚点基线低约 0.046。 锚点处的块跳过门限在较低的 SSIM 下提供了额外的加速（2.00–3.54×，对比干净完整锚点基线的 1.94×）。

paragraphs.en: On a full-compute trace, the exact residual 𝐮 \mathbf{u} of every transformer block is split on the token grid into a low-frequency band (two levels of 2 × 2 2\times 2 average pooling, upsampled) and the high-frequency remainder. This probes where reuse error lives in the residuals; the deployed controller instead measures latent drift with a single 2 × 2 2\times 2 pool (Eq. 2 ). For each cache age k ∈ { 1 , … , 10 } k\in\{1,\dots,10\} we replay the band of the residual cached k k steps earlier and measure its relative- L 2 L_{2} deviation from the exact band (Fig. 5 (a)). The profiling set contains six prompts; the lowest-error and highest-error prompts, i.e., those with the lowest and highest mean reuse error, are a static museum statue and a texture-rich koi pond, respectively. The HF/LF ratio (Fig. 5 (b)) decreases from 2.67 2.67 to 2.11 2.11 on the lowest-error prompt and from 2.41 2.41 to 1.99 1.99 on the highest-error prompt over ages 1 → 10 1{\to}10 . Pooling the lower- and higher-error halves of the six prompts preserves this ordering at every age ( 2.51 → 2.04 2.51{\to}2.04 vs. 2.43 → 1.98 2.43{\to}1.98 ), and HF stays above LF on all six prompts individually.

paragraphs.en: Because the HF/LF separation is content-dependent, a design that assigns tokens to two independently fixed anchor schedules according to their frequency content would be mis-calibrated precisely on high-error prompts, where the gap between bands is smallest. FSC therefore uses frequency content as a soft input to a per-step risk score (Sec. 4.2 ): high-frequency drift detects local detail and texture change, low-frequency drift detects coarse structural shift, and cache age guards against tokens with small per-step but large accumulated drift.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 HF/LF 分离依赖于内容，若采用一种根据频率内容将标记分配给两个独立固定的锚定调度的设计，则恰恰会在高错误提示上出现校准偏差，因为此时两个频段之间的差距最小。 因此，FSC 将频率内容作为每步风险分数的软输入（第 4.2 节）：高频漂移可检测局部细节和纹理变化，低频漂移可检测粗略的结构变化，而缓存年龄则能防止那些每步漂移虽小但累积漂移较大的标记。

paragraphs.en: First, d s , i B d^{\mathrm{B}}_{s,i} measures drift of the evolving latent relative to the anchor latent; it is a proxy, not a direct measurement of residual error (validated in Appendix C ). Second, for tokens repaired between anchors, drift is still measured against the anchor reference, so their risk is systematically over-estimated. This makes the routing decision conservative: over-estimation can only move the controller toward more computation at the step level. Third, frequency is used as a soft cache-validity signal rather than a permanent partition of tokens into independently scheduled bands, because the HF/LF separation narrows modestly on higher-error prompts (Fig. 5 (b)).

paragraphs.en: In the implementation the anchor latent reference is rewritten by exactly one routine, which is invoked only on scheduled anchor steps; the risk-triggered full repair shares the full-recompute path (rewriting the residual cache state and resetting ages and accumulated drift) but never invokes the reference-rewriting routine, so the reference is pinned to the last scheduled anchor by construction. paragraphs.en: SkyReels-V2 operates over spatial tokens and temporal groups within a diffusion-forcing sliding window, and classifier-free guidance introduces separate conditional and unconditional forward phases. FSC keeps independent controller state for each compatible (phase, group) context, so cache age, accumulated drift, frequency references, and cached residuals are never mixed across incompatible contexts, and group-local denoising steps determine both anchor scheduling and phase-aware routing.
paragraphs.zh: SkyReels-V2 在扩散驱动的滑动窗口内对空间标记和时间组进行操作，而免分类器引导则引入了独立的条件和非条件前向阶段。 FSC 为每个兼容的（阶段、组）上下文保留独立的控制器状态，因此缓存年龄、累积漂移、频率参考和缓存残差绝不会在不同不兼容的上下文中混合，且组内局部去噪步骤同时决定了锚点调度和阶段感知路由。

sents.zh: 块级阈值仅在 MAGI 的块级专用阶段中读取，而每个 FSC 运行都会禁用该阶段；同时，令牌预算上限保持其原始值不变，因此 LF 权重 w LF w_{\mathrm{LF}} 和修复比例缩放因子 q scale q_{\mathrm{scale}} 对 MAGI-1 没有影响。

sents.en: The dense-to-sparse schedule runs on MAGI’s global denoising-step counter; at scheduled anchors the reuse thresholds are set to zero, forcing exact computation, and the age-control principle is realized through a forced full recomputation every k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}} steps of the same counter.
sents.zh: 稠密到稀疏调度基于 MAGI 的全局降噪步数计数器运行；在预定的锚点处，重用阈值被设为零，从而强制进行精确计算，而年龄控制原则则通过每 k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}} 步对同一计数器进行一次强制完整重计算来实现。

paragraphs.en: Per denoising step, the SkyReels controller performs one 2 × 2 2\times 2 spatial average pool, an upsampling and subtraction to obtain the two bands, and per-token norm and ranking operations. The latent band operations are linear in the latent size, while percentile computation and token ranking add an 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\log N) per-group term in the token count N N . No auxiliary network or additional transformer pass is required. A GPU micro-benchmark with the deployed shapes ( 10,200 10{,}200 tokens per group; 612 612 routing decisions per video, both guidance phases, weighted by the measured routing shares, plus one band extraction per forward) gives about 0.23 0.23 s per video, under 0.2 % 0.2\% of the 161 161 s generation latency; band extraction alone is below 0.05 % 0.05\% . The measured acceleration comes from skipping transformer residual computation through whole-step replay and selective token reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个去噪步骤中，SkyReels 控制器执行一次 2×2 空间平均池化、一次上采样和减法操作以获得两个频段，并进行每个标记的归一化和排序操作。 潜在频带的操作在潜在尺寸上是线性的，而百分位计算和标记排序会在标记数量 N 中为每个组增加一个 𝒪(N log N) 的项。 无需任何辅助网络或额外的 Transformer 处理步骤。 使用部署形状（每组 10,200 个标记；每段视频 612 次路由决策，包含两个引导阶段，按测得的路由份额加权，外加每次前向传播一次频段提取）进行的 GPU 微基准测试显示，每段视频耗时约 0.23 秒，占 161 秒生成延迟的不到 0.2%；仅频段提取部分则低于 0.05%。 测得的加速效果源于通过整步重播和选择性标记重用跳过了 Transformer 残差计算。

paragraphs.en: We measure how strongly the deployed FSC staleness risk ρ s \rho_{s} (Eq. 4 ) is associated with the error incurred by residual reuse. This controlled profiling experiment uses the SkyReels-V2 1.3B backbone with our development set (eight prompts; App. D ) and a development configuration of the same family: the risk weights, k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}} , k step k_{\mathrm{step}} , thresholds, repair fractions, and phase shaping of App. D , but W = 7 W{=}7 , n = 9 n{=}9 , r = 1.75 r{=}1.75 , q scale = 1.00 q_{\mathrm{scale}}{=}1.00 , and p LF = 0.1 p_{\mathrm{LF}}{=}0.1 . This yields 4,896 4{,}896 eligible non-anchor controller decisions. At each decision, we evaluate the exact residuals for oracle measurement. The probe leaves the anchor reference, token ages, accumulated drift, and routing state unchanged, but overwrites the probed group’s K/V cache. Simpler predictors computed from the same decisions are informative too: the number of steps since the last scheduled anchor alone reaches Spearman 0.865 0.865 (ROC-AUC 0.913 0.913 ), the age term alone 0.715 0.715 , and the HF or LF drift term alone 0.859 0.859 / 0.867 0.867 ; ρ s \rho_{s} adds 0.028 0.028 Spearman over the elapsed-step predictor, and its partial Spearman correlation with E s E_{s} controlling for elapsed steps is 0.472 0.472 , against 0.174 0.174 for elapsed steps controlling for ρ s \rho_{s} . End-to-end quality and acceleration are evaluated separately at benchmark scale in Sec. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们衡量已部署的 FSC 陈旧风险 ρ s \rho_{s}（公式 4）与残留重用所导致的错误之间的关联强度。这项受控剖析实验使用 SkyReels-V2 1.3B 主干模型以及我们的开发数据集（八个提示；附录 D），并采用同一系列的开发配置：风险权重 k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}}、k step k_{\mathrm{step}}、阈值、修复比例和阶段塑造均与附录 D 中的一致，但 W = 7 W{=}7、n = 9 n{=}9、r = 1.75 r{=}1.75、q scale = 1.00 q_{\mathrm{scale}}{=}1.00、p LF = 0.1 p_{\mathrm{LF}}{=}0.1。由此产生了 4,896 个符合条件的非锚点控制器决策。在每个决策点，我们都会通过神谕测量来评估精确的残留值。该探针会保留锚点参考、令牌年龄、累积漂移和路由状态不变，但会覆盖被探测组的 K/V 缓存。基于相同决策计算出的更简单的预测指标同样具有信息价值：仅从上次调度锚点以来经过的步骤数即可达到斯皮尔曼相关系数 0.865（ROC-AUC 为 0.913）；仅年龄项可达 0.715；而 HF 或 LF 漂移项单独可达 0.859 / 0.867。ρ s \rho_{s} 在已过去步骤预测指标的基础上额外贡献了 0.028 的斯皮尔曼相关系数，并且在控制已过去步骤的情况下，它与 E s E_{s} 的部分斯皮尔曼相关性为 0.472，而相比之下，在控制 ρ s \rho_{s} 的情况下，已过去步骤的相关性仅为 0.174。端到端的质量与加速将在第 5 节的基准测试规模上分别进行评估。

paragraphs.en: All main-table experiments run on a single server with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs ( 97,887 97{,}887 MiB of reported device memory, corresponding to 102.6 102.6 GB; GB denotes 10 9 10^{9} bytes throughout; driver 570.211.01), PyTorch 2.11.0 with CUDA 12.8, and bfloat16 inference. Each video is generated on one GPU with batch size 1; timed runs are launched only on GPUs with no other process, and runs later slowed by co-located jobs are flagged post hoc (Timing Procedure below). VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2025 ) evaluation uses the official repository at commit 45e79ec in long_vbench_standard mode (each video scored on the VBench-Long dimensions of its prompt set with the canonical short prompt); the four GRiT-based semantic dimensions run in a separate detectron2 environment. The reported VBench aggregate uses a fixed subset of eleven dimensions: subject consistency, motion smoothness and dynamic degree (subject-consistency prompts), overall consistency, aesthetic quality and imaging quality (overall-consistency prompts), scene and background consistency (scene prompts), and color, object class and appearance style (their own prompt sets); every dimension is scored on its complete VBench-Long prompt set ( 505 505 prompts in total) with the official normalization and dimension weights, and, as in the official implementation, a video in which the detector finds no object of the prompt is excluded from that method’s color mean. On MAGI-1, speedups are per-prompt ratios over the vanilla-clean prompt pool after per-method latency auditing; VBench aggregates use the evaluated dimension subset on 500 500 prompts (five color prompts in which the detector finds the object for no method contribute nothing), and fidelity uses the first ten prompts of each prompt set without removing Dev ( 110 110 prompts). LPIPS uses the AlexNet variant ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) ; SSIM and PSNR are computed per frame against the same-seed vanilla video and averaged; for every method, including the baselines, the reference is the decoded same-seed vanilla video.
paragraphs.zh: 所有主表实验均在一台配备 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 的服务器上运行（报告的设备内存为 97,887 MiB，相当于 102.6 GB；全文中 GB 表示 10⁹ 字节；驱动程序版本为 570.211.01），使用 PyTorch 2.11.0、CUDA 12.8 和 bfloat16 推理。 每个视频均在单块 GPU 上以批量大小 1 生成；计时运行仅在无其他进程占用的 GPU 上启动，而因同位置作业导致后续运行变慢的情况会在事后标记（见下方的“计时流程”）。 VBench-Long（Huang 等，2025）评估使用官方仓库中 commit 45e79ec 的 long_vbench_standard 模式（每个视频均基于其提示集在 VBench-Long 维度上，使用标准短提示进行评分）；四个基于 GRiT 的语义维度则在独立的 detectron2 环境中运行。 报告的 VBench 聚合结果使用一个固定的十一维子集：主体一致性、运动平滑度和动态程度（主体一致性提示）、整体一致性、美学质量和成像质量（整体一致性提示）、场景与背景一致性（场景提示），以及颜色、物体类别和外观风格（各自的提示集）；每个维度均基于其完整的 VBench-Long 提示集（共 505 个提示）进行评分，并使用官方归一化和维度权重；与官方实现一致，若检测器在视频中未找到提示所指定的物体，则该视频不会被纳入该方法的颜色均值计算。 在 MAGI-1 上，加速比是各方法经过延迟审计后相对于基础干净提示池的每个提示比率；VBench 聚合结果使用评估子集在 500 个提示上进行计算（其中五个颜色提示中，若检测器未找到任何方法对应的物体，则不贡献任何值），而保真度则使用每个提示集的前十个提示，且不移除 Dev（共 110 个提示）。 LPIPS 使用 AlexNet 变体（Zhang 等，2018）；SSIM 和 PSNR 按帧计算相对于相同种子生成的基础视频，并取平均值；对于所有方法（包括基线方法），参考视频均为解码后的相同种子基础视频。

paragraphs.en: On SkyReels-V2 the executed-token trace of every transformer block is recorded for all 946 946 prompts after the token-cache warmup; the untraced warmup and overlap-prefix forwards are full computations and are added for every method, vanilla included (five full forwards per temporal group for FlowCache and MotionCache, i.e., their warmup 4 4 plus the cache-initializing step that follows it; two for FSC and the SeaCache port). PFLOPs follow from the per-token cost of the block’s linear layers and self-attention over the group’s own tokens, with the unconditional pass charged as the conditional one; attention to cached context keys and cross-attention are not charged, so SkyReels-V2 PFLOPs are comparable across methods but are not a complete count and are not on the same basis as the MAGI-1 values. The MAGI-1 runtime exposes no such trace, so we instrument its block stack to count executed token-slots and attended query–key pairs per forward and compare them against the vanilla schedule replayed for the same step. The analytic vanilla cost is 140.6 140.6 PFLOPs per video ( 12,150 12{,}150 tokens per chunk, seven chunks, 64 64 steps, a four-chunk denoising window with the model’s noise2clean_kvrange ; linear layers 55.9 55.9 , self-attention 84.2 84.2 , cross-attention with caption projections 0.5 0.5 PFLOPs), 1.2 % 1.2\% above the 139 139 PFLOPs reported by MotionCache for the identical setting, and the instrumented counter reproduces it exactly ( 1.000 1.000 ) on a vanilla run. Each cached method’s PFLOPs is this vanilla cost times its measured executed fraction: FlowCache on the full run, MotionCache and both FSC points on the same instrumented 20 20 -prompt sample (both FSC points were instrumented separately with the same counter; FSC-Quality’s per-prompt latencies reproduce its benchmark run within 1 % 1\% ). Sparse forwards are charged for executed query tokens only, matching the SkyReels-V2 convention; charging the full reassembled key/value length instead changes the MAGI-1 fractions by less than 0.03 0.03 .
paragraphs.zh: 在 SkyReels-V2 中，经过词元缓存预热后，所有 946,946 个提示中每个 Transformer 块的已执行词元轨迹都会被记录；未追踪的预热阶段和重叠前缀前向计算则是完整的计算过程，并且对于所有方法（包括原始方法）都会加入计算量（FlowCache 和 MotionCache 每个时间组需进行五次完整的前向计算，即它们的预热阶段（4+4）以及紧随其后的缓存初始化步骤；FSC 和 SeaCache 端口则各需两次）。 PFLOPs 的计算基于该块线性层和自注意力在每个词元上的成本，且针对该组自身词元的处理；无条件通过计算则按条件通过计算计费。对已缓存上下文键和交叉注意力的计算不计入成本，因此 SkyReels-V2 的 PFLOPs 值在不同方法间具有可比性，但并非完整统计量，也与 MAGI-1 的数值不在同一计算基础上。 MAGI-1 的运行时间未提供此类轨迹信息，因此我们对它的块堆栈进行了插装，以统计每次前向计算中已执行的词元槽位和参与的查询-键对，并将其与为相同步骤重放的原始计算流程进行对比。 分析得出的原始计算成本为每视频 140.6 PFLOPs（每个分块 12,150 个词元，共七个分块，64 步，使用模型 noise2clean_kvrange 的四个分块去噪窗口；线性层为 55.9 PFLOPs，自注意力为 84.2 PFLOPs，包含标题投影的交叉注意力为 0.5 PFLOPs），比 MotionCache 在相同设置下报告的 139 PFLOPs 高出 1.2%，而插装计数器在原始运行中的结果与之完全一致（1.000）。 每种缓存方法的 PFLOPs 等于该原始成本乘以其测得的已执行比例：FlowCache 基于完整运行，MotionCache 和两个 FSC 数据点则基于相同的插装 20 提示样本（两个 FSC 数据点均使用同一计数器独立插装；FSC-Quality 的每个提示延迟在 1% 范围内与基准运行结果一致）。 稀疏前向计算仅对已执行的查询词元计费，这与 SkyReels-V2 的惯例一致；若改为对重组后的完整键/值长度计费，则 MAGI-1 的比例变化将小于 0.03。

paragraphs.en: Latency is wall-clock time of the complete generation call, bracketed by torch.cuda.synchronize() , measured per prompt. Speedup is computed per prompt as the same-prompt vanilla latency divided by the method latency on the same GPU model, then averaged over prompts; vanilla latencies are measured once per prompt and cached. Because latency is sensitive to co-located jobs on shared servers, all timed runs are launched on otherwise-idle GPUs, and a post-hoc audit flags any run whose latency leaves the per-configuration clean band (the fastest-quintile latency + 2 % +2\% ; on idle GPUs the latency of a fixed workload varies by less than 1 % 1\% ). The flagged SkyReels-V2 runs ( 348 348 of the 946 946 runs of the W = 5 W{=}5 , r = 1.65 r{=}1.65 operating point of Table 6 , generated while other jobs shared its GPUs, and one FSC-Speed run) were re-measured on idle GPUs, after which every vanilla, FlowCache, and FSC run lies inside its band and all speedups of Table 6 average over all 946 946 prompts. MotionCache’s and SeaCache-AR’s executed compute varies more across prompts, which places 95 95 and 530 530 of their runs above this band; measured instead against the latency predicted from each run’s executed compute, no MotionCache run and five SeaCache-AR runs are more than 2 % 2\% slower, and excluding those five would change SeaCache-AR’s speedup by 0.001 × 0.001\times . On MAGI-1, where cached latency depends strongly on the prompt, the band is taken around each prompt’s latency predicted from the other cached methods; it flags 8 8 of 4,730 4{,}730 cached runs, none of them from the two FSC points of Table 1 , and without it FlowCache would print 1.485 × 1.485\times .
paragraphs.zh: 延迟是指完整生成调用的实际运行时间，由 torch.cuda.synchronize() 标记起止，并按每个提示词单独测量。 加速比按每个提示词计算：使用相同提示词的原始方法延迟除以同一 GPU 模型上该方法对应的延迟，再对所有提示词取平均；原始方法的延迟每个提示词仅测量一次并缓存。 由于延迟对共享服务器上共定位的任务较为敏感，所有计时运行均在原本空闲的 GPU 上启动，并通过事后审计标记任何延迟超出该配置干净范围（最快五分位延迟 +2%；在空闲 GPU 上，固定工作负载的延迟变化小于 1%）的运行。 被标记的 SkyReels-V2 运行（表 6 中 W = 5、r = 1.65 工作点的 946 次运行中的 348 次，这些运行是在其他任务共享其 GPU 时生成的，此外还有 1 次 FSC-Speed 运行）在空闲 GPU 上重新测量；此后，所有原始方法、FlowCache 和 FSC 的运行均位于其指定范围内，且表 6 中的所有加速比均基于全部 946 个提示词计算得出。 MotionCache 和 SeaCache-AR 的执行计算量在不同提示词间差异较大，导致它们中有 95 次和 530 次运行超出了该范围；改为根据每次运行实际执行的计算量预测延迟后，没有 MotionCache 的运行比预测值慢超过 2%，而 SeaCache-AR 仅有 5 次运行超出；若排除这 5 次，SeaCache-AR 的加速比将变化 0.001 倍。 在 MAGI-1 上，由于缓存延迟对提示词高度依赖，其范围以每个提示词通过其他缓存方法预测的延迟为中心确定；该范围标记了 4,730 次缓存运行中的 8 次，且无一来自表 1 的两个 FSC 点；若不计入这些标记，FlowCache 的加速比将显示为 1.485 倍。

sents.zh: 在 MAGI-1 上，由于缓存延迟对提示词高度依赖，其范围以每个提示词通过其他缓存方法预测的延迟为中心确定；该范围标记了 4,730 次缓存运行中的 8 次，且无一来自表 1 的两个 FSC 点；若不计入这些标记，FlowCache 的加速比将显示为 1.485 倍。

paragraphs.en: On MAGI-1 all three cached methods peak at 19.7 19.7 GB against 31.8 31.8 GB for the vanilla runtime: the shared FlowCache/MotionCache runtime on which all three are built drops nearly-clean chunks from the attention window ( discard_nearly_clean_chunk , its released default), which lowers the footprint for FlowCache, MotionCache, and FSC alike, and the three cache states themselves are indistinguishable at this granularity. FlowCache’s KV-cache compression, one of its two components, is disabled in every FlowCache row (the shared SkyReels-V2 runtime does not implement it; on MAGI-1 it is left off, as for every other method), so these rows measure FlowCache’s reuse policy alone. Compression would lower FlowCache’s memory below the shared baseline and may also reduce its attention cost; Table 1 credits neither effect.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MAGI-1 上，三种缓存方法均达到 19.7 GB 的峰值，而原始运行时则为 31.8 GB：它们所基于的共享 FlowCache/MotionCache 运行时会从注意力窗口中丢弃“近乎干净的块”（discard_nearly_clean_chunk，其默认已启用），从而降低了 FlowCache、MotionCache 和 FSC 的内存占用，且在此粒度下，这三种缓存状态本身无法区分。 FlowCache 的 KV 缓存压缩是其两个组件之一，但在每个 FlowCache 行中均被禁用（共享的 SkyReels-V2 运行时未实现该功能；在 MAGI-1 上，它与其他所有方法一样处于关闭状态），因此这些行仅测量了 FlowCache 的重用策略。 压缩功能会将 FlowCache 的内存占用降至共享基线以下，并可能降低其注意力成本；表 1 未体现这两种效应中的任何一种。

paragraphs.en: MotionCache is run from its official repository with the released backbone-specific configuration (SkyReels-V2: threshold 0.1 0.1 , warmup 4 4 , K = 6 K{=}6 , α = 0.6 \alpha{=}0.6 ; MAGI-1: rel- L 1 L_{1} 0.0065 0.0065 , warmup 5 5 , token-wise reuse on), on the same machine, seed, and prompts as all other rows; the absolute speedups reported in the MotionCache paper correspond to a different hardware and runtime setting and are therefore not comparable to Table 1 , whereas the ordering of methods is preserved (verified on an H100 in Table 5 ). FlowCache is reproduced inside the same shared FlowCache/MotionCache codebase as its chunk-wise special case—the configuration the MotionCache paper identifies as FlowCache ( K = 17 K{=}17 in its sweep, i.e., the coarse full update applied throughout generation, without token-level selectivity): on SkyReels-V2 a group-level reuse/recompute gate with FlowCache’s threshold 0.1 0.1 and MotionCache’s warmup 4 4 ; on MAGI-1 the chunk-wise rel- L 1 L_{1} policy with FlowCache’s official VBench setting (threshold 0.01 0.01 , warmup 5 5 ) and token-wise reuse disabled. FlowCache’s KV-cache compression is disabled (App. D ), so these rows reproduce its reuse policy only. The FlowCache paper reports larger speedups ( 2.38 × 2.38\times on MAGI-1, 6.7 × 6.7\times on SkyReels-V2) in its own evaluation setting and configuration. In our setting, the official FlowCache repository’s SkyReels-V2 stack without compression is 2.21 × 2.21\times faster than its own vanilla on a probe prompt ( 368 368 vs. 166 166 s), close to our reproduction ( 180 180 s, 2.04 × 2.04\times ) at comparable fidelity (SSIM 0.758 0.758 vs. 0.756 0.756 ); the gap to the published SkyReels-V2 number therefore comes from differences in evaluation setting and configuration, not from the reimplementation. We therefore evaluate all rows on a common stack because the official stack’s vanilla output diverges from the MotionCache-fork vanilla at the same seed (SSIM 0.92 0.92 between the two references), which would make same-seed fidelity incomparable across rows. ARCache ( Nan et al., 2026 ) , which evaluates FramePack-F1, SkyReels-V2, and the original Matrix-Game, has no public implementation as of September 2026 and reports results under different settings (e.g., 257 frames in 30 steps on SkyReels-V2 and the GameWorld benchmark on Matrix-Game), so it is not included.
paragraphs.zh: MotionCache 是从其官方仓库中运行的，使用了针对特定骨干网络的已发布配置（SkyReels-V2：阈值 0.1 0.1，预热 4 4，K = 6 K{=}6，α = 0.6 \alpha{=}0.6；MAGI-1：rel- L 1 L_{1} 0.0065 0.0065，预热 5 5，启用基于 token 的重用），且与所有其他行使用相同的机器、种子和提示；MotionCache 论文中报告的绝对加速值对应不同的硬件和运行时设置，因此无法与表 1 进行比较，但各方法的顺序得到了保留（在表 5 中通过 H100 验证）。FlowCache 是在同一个共享的 FlowCache/MotionCache 代码库中作为其基于 chunk 的特例复现的——该配置正是 MotionCache 论文中识别为 FlowCache 的设置（在其参数扫描中 K = 17 K{=}17，即在整个生成过程中应用的粗略完整更新，没有 token 级别的選擇性）：在 SkyReels-V2 上，采用组级别的重用/重新计算门控机制，结合 FlowCache 的阈值 0.1 0.1 和 MotionCache 的预热 4 4；在 MAGI-1 上，则采用基于 chunk 的 rel- L 1 L_{1} 策略，结合 FlowCache 的官方 VBench 设置（阈值 0.01 0.01，预热 5 5），并禁用基于 token 的重用。FlowCache 的 KV-cache 压缩功能被禁用（附录 D），因此这些行仅复现了其重用策略。FlowCache 论文在其自身的评估设置和配置下报告了更高的加速值（MAGI-1 上为 2.38 × 2.38\times，SkyReels-V2 上为 6.7 × 6.7\times）。在我们的设置中，官方 FlowCache 仓库中 SkyReels-V2 堆栈在未压缩的情况下，在探测提示上的速度比其自身的原始版本快 2.21 × 2.21\times（368 368 秒 vs. 166 166 秒），接近我们复现的结果（180 180 秒，2.04 × 2.04\times），且保持了相当的保真度（SSIM 0.758 0.758 vs. 0.756 0.756）；因此，与已发表的 SkyReels-V2 数据之间的差距源于评估设置和配置的不同，而非重新实现本身。为此，我们在一个共同的堆栈上评估所有行，因为官方堆栈的原始输出在相同种子下与 MotionCache 分支的原始输出存在差异（两个参考结果之间的 SSIM 为 0.92 0.92），这会导致不同行之间相同种子的保真度无法比较。ARCache（Nan et al., 2026）评估了 FramePack-F1、SkyReels-V2 和原始 Matrix-Game，但截至 2026 年 9 月尚未有公开实现，且其结果是在不同设置下报告的（例如，在 SkyReels-V2 上为 30 步内 257 帧，在 Matrix-Game 的 GameWorld 基准上），因此未被纳入。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists the SkyReels-V2 FSC operating points used elsewhere in the paper, and Fig. 8 plots FSC-Quality and the three faster W = 5 W{=}5 points (FSC-Speed with r = 1.55 r{=}1.55 , r = 1.65 r{=}1.65 , and r = 1.65 r{=}1.65 with two tail anchors at steps 44 44 and 47 47 ) against MotionCache. Every FSC point improves PSNR and SSIM over MotionCache at a VBench aggregate within 0.005 0.005 of it while running 0 0 – 7.5 % 7.5\% faster, and all but the fastest also improve LPIPS. Dense-to-sparse anchors control the global refresh frequency and selective token repair recovers locally stale content between anchors, so FSC can spend computation continuously along the frontier instead of choosing between full reuse and full recompute.
paragraphs.zh: 表6列出了本文其他部分使用的 SkyReels-V2 FSC 运行点，图8则将 FSC-Quality 和三个速度更快的 W = 5 W{=}5 运行点（FSC-Speed，其中 r = 1.55 r{=}1.55、r = 1.65 r{=}1.65，以及在第44步和第47步设置两个尾部锚点的 r = 1.65 r{=}1.65）与 MotionCache 进行了对比。 每个 FSC 运行点都比 MotionCache 在 PSNR 和 SSIM 上有所提升，且 VBench 综合性能差异不超过 0.005，同时运行速度提升了 0%–7.5%；除最快的运行点外，其余所有运行点也提升了 LPIPS。 稠密到稀疏的锚点控制着全局刷新频率，而选择性标记修复则能在锚点之间恢复局部过时的内容，因此 FSC 可以沿着边界持续分配计算资源，而非在完全复用和完全重算之间做出选择。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists the three FSC configurations evaluated on the full MAGI-1 benchmark. The three configurations trace different operating points of MAGI-1’s native cache interface. The fifteen-anchor configurations provide the strongest fidelity, while increasing k tok k_{\mathrm{tok}} from 4 4 to 8 8 gives a faster operating point; Table 1 reports the two fifteen-anchor points (FSC-Quality with k tok = 4 k_{\mathrm{tok}}{=}4 ; FSC-Speed with k tok = 8 k_{\mathrm{tok}}{=}8 ). On the 110 110 fidelity prompts, where every accelerated output has a same-seed vanilla reference, the VBench aggregate of every cached method (computed over the 60 60 of these prompts that carry the evaluated dimensions) lies within the vanilla bootstrap CI (paired VBench differences: FSC-Quality − - MotionCache − 0.009 -0.009 [ − 0.030 , + 0.016 ] [-0.030,+0.016] , FSC-Quality − - vanilla + 0.013 +0.013 [ − 0.005 , + 0.032 ] [-0.005,+0.032] ). On this distilled backbone the opportunity for reuse between scheduled full recomputations is limited by the 16 16 denoising steps a chunk spends at each of the four window positions ( 64 64 steps per chunk in total), which is why the FSC frontier on MAGI-1 spans a narrower speed range than on SkyReels-V2.

paragraphs.en: Backbones. FramePack-F1 ( FramePack_F1_I2V_HY_20250503 , HunyuanVideo-based next-section prediction; 25 25 steps, distilled guidance 10 10 , 145 145 frames at the 640 640 bucket, seed 31337 31337 , image-to-video from frame 0 0 of the SkyReels-V2 vanilla video) and the Matrix-Game-3.0 base model (Wan2.2-5B based; 50 50 steps, CFG 5.0 5.0 , shift 5.0 5.0 , 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 , 177 177 frames, seed 42 42 ; held-out prompts are likewise conditioned on frame 0 0 of the SkyReels-V2 vanilla video). Port. The full controller runs with gathered-token execution as on SkyReels-V2 (selected tokens run every block on a compact batch and attend to the full cached keys and values), with separate controller state per CFG branch. Calibration. FSC is calibrated per backbone on eight development prompts over W W , n n , E E , r r , q scale q_{\mathrm{scale}} and ( k tok , k step ) (k_{\mathrm{tok}},k_{\mathrm{step}}) ; a configuration is eligible if its median latency is within 5 % 5\% of the transferred SkyReels configuration, its LPIPS is not worse, and its PSNR is at most 0.1 0.1 dB lower; the eligible configuration with the highest SSIM is selected; the final configurations are listed in App. D . The coupled comparator is the purely reactive variant of Sec. 5.3 : the same controller with warmup but no scheduled anchors, so risk-triggered full repairs also re-base the reference; its threshold scale is calibrated on the development prompts toward FSC’s latency ( r = 0.9 r{=}0.9 and 0.543 0.543 ). Evaluation. Each backbone is evaluated on 40 40 held-out prompts stratified over the benchmark prompt sets and never used for calibration; fidelity is SSIM/PSNR/LPIPS to the same-seed vanilla output (the implementation of Table 1 ); CIs are stratified bootstrap ( B = 10,000 B{=}10{,}000 ) and wins are per-prompt. Timing. Latency ratios and speedups come from a same-GPU re-timing in which each prompt’s controllers run back to back on one idle GPU; vanilla, re-timed on five prompts per backbone, agrees with the original timing within 0.2 % 0.2\% . The re-timing reproduces the fidelity of the validation runs (mean | Δ ​ SSIM | ≤ 0.006 |\Delta\mathrm{SSIM}|\leq 0.006 on FramePack, 0 0 on Matrix-Game), and its latency ratios agree with those of the validation runs, which used several GPUs, to within 0.001 0.001 . Transferred configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 骨干模型。 FramePack-F1（FramePack_F1_I2V_HY_20250503，基于 HunyuanVideo 的下一节预测；25 步，蒸馏引导 10，640×640 桶中 145 帧，种子 31337，从 SkyReels-V2 原始视频的第 0 帧生成图像到视频）以及 Matrix-Game-3.0 基础模型（基于 Wan2.2-5B；50 步，CFG 5.0，shift 5.0，704×1280，177 帧，种子 42；保留的提示同样以 SkyReels-V2 原始视频的第 0 帧为条件）。端口。 完整的控制器以与 SkyReels-V2 相同的方式运行聚集令牌执行（每个块中仅运行选定的令牌，但会关注完整的缓存键和值），且每个 CFG 分支都有独立的控制器状态。校准。 FSC 针对每个骨干模型，在 W W、n n、E E、r r、q scale q_{\mathrm{scale}} 以及 (k tok, k step) (k_{\mathrm{tok}},k_{\mathrm{step}}) 上的八个开发提示中进行校准；若某配置的介质延迟与迁移的 SkyReels 配置相比在 5% 以内，其 LPIPS 不更差，且 PSNR 最多低 0.1 dB，则该配置有资格入选；最终选择 SSIM 最高的合格配置；最终配置列于附录 D。 耦合比较器是第 5.3 节中纯反应式变体：使用相同控制器并加入预热，但无计划锚点，因此风险触发的完整修复也会重新设定参考基准；其阈值尺度在开发提示上针对 FSC 的延迟进行校准（r = 0.9 和 0.543）。评估。 每个骨干模型均在 40 个保留提示上进行评估，这些提示按基准提示集分层划分，且从未用于校准；保真度通过 SSIM/PSNR/LPIPS 与相同种子的原始输出（表 1 的实现）进行比较；置信区间采用分层自助法（B = 10,000），且每次评估以每个提示为单位。计时。 延迟比和加速来自在同一 GPU 上的重新计时测试，其中每个提示的控制器依次在单个空闲 GPU 上运行；重新计时后的原始模型在每类骨干模型上测试了五个提示，其结果与原始计时结果在 0.2% 以内一致。 重新计时能够复现验证运行的保真度（FramePack 上的平均 |Δ SSIM| ≤ 0.006，Matrix-Game 上为 0），且其延迟比与使用多个 GPU 的验证运行结果在 0.001 以内一致。 迁移配置。

paragraphs.en: We repeated the SkyReels-V2 comparison with four additional seeds ( 7 7 , 42 42 , 123 123 , 2026 2026 ) on a 78 78 -prompt subset stratified over the benchmark prompt sets, generating vanilla, MotionCache, and FSC-Quality for every seed and comparing each accelerated video with the vanilla video of the same seed (Table 10 ). Fidelity margins replicate at every seed and are significant on the 78 78 paired prompts of each added seed (SSIM + 0.021 +0.021 to + 0.044 +0.044 , PSNR + 0.9 +0.9 to + 1.7 +1.7 dB, LPIPS − 0.016 -0.016 to − 0.043 -0.043 ; paired t t -test p ≤ 1.6 × 10 − 5 p\leq 1.6\times 10^{-5} for SSIM and PSNR and p ≤ 0.022 p\leq 0.022 for LPIPS, the largest values both at seed 42 42 ; FSC wins on 52 52 – 71 71 of 78 78 prompts; on the 13 13 prompts of seed 1024 1024 , p = 0.044 p=0.044 / 0.001 0.001 / 0.098 0.098 for SSIM / PSNR / LPIPS); over the five seeds the mean margin is SSIM + 0.035 ± 0.009 +0.035\pm 0.009 , PSNR + 1.25 ± 0.31 +1.25\pm 0.31 dB, LPIPS − 0.031 ± 0.011 -0.031\pm 0.011 , at identical speed ( 2.274 ± 0.002 × 2.274\pm 0.002\times for MotionCache, 2.274 ± 0.001 × 2.274\pm 0.001\times for FSC; per-seed ratio 1.000 ± 0.001 1.000\pm 0.001 ). The seed-to-seed standard deviation of the VBench aggregate is 0.003 0.003 – 0.008 0.008 per method; on this subset FSC is 0.008 ± 0.009 0.008\pm 0.009 below MotionCache on average, from − 0.019 -0.019 (seed 1024 1024 ) to + 0.003 +0.003 (seed 42 42 ), whereas on the full benchmark the same difference is + 0.000 +0.000 (paired bootstrap 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.006 , + 0.006 ] [-0.006,+0.006] )—the 78 78 -prompt subset weights the evaluated dimensions differently from the full benchmark, and MotionCache scores above vanilla on it at two of the five seeds. paragraphs.en: Cross-Stack Comparability. The two runtimes do not compute the same vanilla video: the shared runtime does not forward frame groups that have finished denoising, the upstream runtime processes the whole valid interval. At the same seed their vanilla outputs are different samples (SSIM 0.48 0.48 between them on the 102 102 fidelity prompts) of equal quality (VBench aggregate difference + 0.004 +0.004 [ − 0.023 , + 0.035 ] [-0.023,+0.035] on those prompts), and the upstream vanilla takes 589 589 s per video against 367 367 s. With every step recomputed, SCOPE’s pipeline reproduces the upstream vanilla exactly in the first window (checked on one prompt). We therefore (i) measure SCOPE’s same-seed fidelity only against its own-stack vanilla, generated for the 102 102 fidelity prompts, (ii) normalize its speedup only to that vanilla, and (iii) compare across stacks only what does not depend on the reference trajectory: latency in seconds on the same hardware and the VBench aggregate on the same prompts. Fidelity columns of different stacks therefore measure closeness to different references and should not be interpreted as a common ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 跨栈可比性。 这两个运行时不会计算出相同的原始视频：共享运行时不会转发已完成去噪的帧组，而上游运行时则处理整个有效区间。 在相同种子下，它们的原始输出是质量相等的不同样本（在 102×102 保真提示上，两者之间的 SSIM 为 0.48、0.48），且上游原始视频每段需要 589 秒，而共享运行时仅需 367 秒。 通过每一步重新计算，SCOPE 的流程在第一个窗口中完全复现了上游原始视频（已在单个提示上验证）。 因此，我们 (i) 仅将 SCOPE 的相同种子保真度与其自身栈中的原始视频进行比较，该原始视频是为 102×102 保真提示生成的；(ii) 仅将其加速效果与该原始视频进行归一化；以及 (iii) 在跨栈比较时，仅关注不依赖参考轨迹的部分：即相同硬件上的延迟（秒）以及相同提示上的 VBench 综合得分。 因此，不同栈的保真度列衡量的是与不同参考的接近程度，不应被解释为共同的排名。

paragraphs.en: Because VBench’s per-video dynamic-degree score is coarse (the fraction of clips labelled dynamic), we score the vanilla videos with VBench’s own RAFT pipeline and use the mean top- 5 % 5\% flow magnitude (relative to VBench’s motion threshold) as a continuous motion measure, then split prompts into terciles. On SkyReels-V2 (Table 14 ; 99 99 seed- 7 7 prompts with retained videos: the 98 98 -prompt pool of App. E.4 plus one additional subject-consistency prompt; 13 13 of the 99 99 are also in the 78 78 -prompt seed subset) FSC-Quality is ahead of MotionCache in every tercile, and the margin grows with motion (SSIM + 0.018 +0.018 , + 0.035 +0.035 , + 0.049 +0.049 ; LPIPS − 0.004 -0.004 , − 0.025 -0.025 , − 0.051 -0.051 ). FSC’s motion attenuation appears where vanilla motion is marginal (the mean dynamic-degree score drops by 0.06 0.06 on low-motion prompts) and vanishes in the high-motion tercile. On MAGI-1 ( 110 110 prompts; 88 88 static and 22 22 dynamic by that label) FSC-Quality leads MotionCache on static prompts (SSIM + 0.040 +0.040 , LPIPS − 0.048 -0.048 ) and on dynamic ones (SSIM + 0.048 +0.048 , LPIPS − 0.048 -0.048 ).
paragraphs.zh: 由于 VBench 针对每个视频的动态程度评分较为粗略（即被标记为动态的片段比例），我们使用 VBench 自身的 RAFT 流程对原始视频进行评分，并以前 5% 流强度的均值（相对于 VBench 的运动阈值）作为连续运动度量指标，然后将提示词分为三等分。在 SkyReels-V2 上（表 14；99 个种子提示词，其中保留了视频：附录 E.4 中的 98 个提示词池加上一个额外的主体一致性提示词；这 99 个提示词中有 13 个也包含在 78 个提示词的种子子集中），FSC-Quality 在每个三等分中都优于 MotionCache，且优势随着运动强度的增加而扩大（SSIM +0.018、+0.035、+0.049；LPIPS −0.004、−0.025、−0.051）。FSC 的运动抑制效果在原始视频运动较弱时显现（低运动提示词的平均动态程度评分下降了 0.06），但在高运动三等分中则消失。在 MAGI-1 上（110 个提示词；根据该标签，88 个为静态，22 个为动态），FSC-Quality 在静态提示词（SSIM +0.040、LPIPS −0.048）和动态提示词（SSIM +0.048、LPIPS −0.048）上均优于 MotionCache。

paragraphs.en: On MAGI-1, the VBench dimension on which FSC falls furthest behind MotionCache is dynamic degree . There, FSC-Quality scores 0.295 0.295 and FSC-Speed 0.236 0.236 versus 0.365 0.365 for MotionCache and 0.434 0.434 for FlowCache: with only 16 16 denoising steps per window position on this distilled backbone, reuse between scheduled full recomputations can damp large motions, and this dimension alone accounts for FlowCache’s higher VBench aggregate on MAGI-1. On SkyReels-V2, with 50 50 denoising steps per temporal group and dense early anchors, the effect vanishes in aggregate (App. E.7 : FSC-Quality’s dynamic-degree score is 0.06 0.06 below vanilla on the low-motion tercile and unchanged on the high-motion one): FSC-Quality and MotionCache both score 0.719 0.719 and FSC-Speed 0.722 0.722 (vanilla 0.740 0.740 ). On MAGI-1, highly dynamic prompts are therefore the regime in which more conservative reuse is most important.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MAGI-1 上，FSC 在 VBench 维度中落后于 MotionCache 最明显的方面是动态程度。在此维度上，FSC-Quality 的得分为 0.295 0.295，FSC-Speed 的得分为 0.236 0.236，而 MotionCache 的得分则为 0.365 0.365，FlowCache 的得分更高，为 0.434 0.434：由于该蒸馏主干网络在每个窗口位置仅使用 16 16 次去噪步骤，计划中的完整重新计算之间的重复利用可以抑制大幅度的运动，而仅这一维度就足以解释 FlowCache 在 MAGI-1 上为何拥有更高的 VBench 综合得分。在 SkyReels-V2 上，由于每个时间组使用了 50 50 次去噪步骤并采用了密集的早期锚点，这种效应在综合得分中消失了（附录 E.7：FSC-Quality 的动态程度得分在低运动三分位中比基础模型低 0.06 0.06，在高运动三分位中则保持不变）：FSC-Quality 和 MotionCache 的得分均为 0.719 0.719，FSC-Speed 的得分为 0.722 0.722（基础模型为 0.740 0.740）。因此，在 MAGI-1 上，高度动态的提示正是更为保守的重复利用最为重要的场景。

paragraphs.en: To test cross-scale transfer, we applied the 1.3B FSC-Quality configuration (App. D ) unchanged to SkyReels-V2-DF-14B-540P, without additional hyperparameter search, keeping the same autoregressive settings, seed, and baselines. The 14B model’s per-window key/value cache alone ( ∼ 84 {\sim}84 GB at 540P) does not fit on a single RTX PRO 6000 ( 102.6 102.6 GB) alongside the weights, so all four methods are run at 352 × 640 352\times 640 with the runtime’s CPU-offload setting, which offloads the text encoder and moves the DiT between CPU and GPU across autoregressive windows; everything else (177 frames, 97-frame window, ar_step 5, 50 steps) is identical to Table 1 . MotionCache and FlowCache use their released settings with the 14B TeaCache polynomial. Table 15 reports 47 prompts (five per benchmark prompt set, excluding the development prompts). The VBench aggregate of FSC-Quality ( 0.841 0.841 ) is within the paired bootstrap CI of every other method (FSC-Quality − - MotionCache + 0.008 +0.008 [ − 0.031 , + 0.036 ] [-0.031,+0.036] , FSC-Quality − - FlowCache + 0.011 +0.011 [ − 0.017 , + 0.042 ] [-0.017,+0.042] , FSC-Quality − - vanilla + 0.009 +0.009 [ − 0.014 , + 0.031 ] [-0.014,+0.031] ).
paragraphs.zh: 为测试跨尺度迁移效果，我们将 1.3B FSC-Quality 配置（附录 D）直接应用于 SkyReels-V2-DF-14B-540P，未进行额外的超参数搜索，并保留了相同的自回归设置、随机种子和基线模型。仅 14B 模型每窗口的键/值缓存（在 540P 分辨率下约为 84 GB）便无法与模型权重一同装入单块 RTX PRO 6000（102.6 GB），因此所有四种方法均在 352 × 640 分辨率下运行，并启用运行时 CPU 卸载设置：该设置会将文本编码器卸载至 CPU，并在自回归窗口间将 DiT 在 CPU 和 GPU 之间切换；其余所有参数（177 帧、97 帧窗口、ar_step = 5、50 步）均与表 1 一致。MotionCache 和 FlowCache 使用其已发布的设置，并结合 14B TeaCache 多项式。表 15 报告了 47 个提示（每个基准提示集包含五个提示，不含开发用提示）。FSC-Quality 的 VBench 综合得分（0.841）位于所有其他方法的配对自助置信区间内（FSC-Quality − MotionCache + 0.008 [−0.031, +0.036]；FSC-Quality − FlowCache + 0.011 [−0.017, +0.042]；FSC-Quality − vanilla + 0.009 [−0.014, +0.031]）。

sents.en: Local errors are therefore not interchangeable: an early one is amplified several times more than a late one, which is the mechanism behind Observation 1 and the reason anchor gaps should grow along the trajectory; it says nothing about which growing schedule to use.
sents.zh: 因此，局部误差并非可互换的：早期出现的局部误差会被放大得比晚期出现的误差多得多，这正是观察 1 背后的机制，也是锚点间隙应沿轨迹增大的原因；但这并未说明应采用哪种增长方案。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate whether a local surrogate can recover the schedule. From instrumented full-compute traces of eight profiling prompts we measure, for every candidate anchor i i and later step s s , the mismatch between the cached whole-step residual of i i and the exact residual of s s , and minimize the summed mismatch over ten anchors by dynamic programming, with and without weighting each term by g ⁡ ( s ) g(s) ; we also draw 500 500 random ten-anchor schedules. The hand-crafted schedule sits in the best 10 % 10\% of the random schedules but is not the surrogate optimum: the unweighted optimum is nearly uniform (gaps 3 , 3 , 3 , 4 , 4 , 4 , 4 , 4 , 4 3,3,3,4,4,4,4,4,4 ), and the g g -weighted optima are dense-to-sparse in shape (gaps 2 , 3 , 3 , 3 , 4 , 4 , 4 , 5 , 5 2,3,3,3,4,4,4,5,5 and 2 , 2 , 3 , 3 , 4 , 4 , 5 , 5 , 5 2,2,3,3,4,4,5,5,5 ). End-to-end, however, every one of them is outperformed by the hand-crafted schedule with the rest of FSC-Quality held fixed on our development set (Table 17 ; Fig. 10 (b)), and the surrogate mis-orders the schedules it can compare (it ranks uniform ahead of dense-to-sparse). The surrogate-optimal schedules run 2.6 % 2.6\% faster; this latency difference can account for at most about 0.008 0.008 SSIM of their 0.008 0.008 – 0.020 0.020 deficit. The influence curve therefore motivates growing gaps; the anchor locations themselves are selected empirically.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们评估局部代理模型能否恢复调度方案。 通过对八个分析提示的全量计算轨迹进行仪器化测量，我们为每个候选锚点 i 和后续步骤 s，衡量了 i 的缓存完整步骤残差与 s 的精确残差之间的不匹配程度，并通过动态规划最小化十个锚点的总不匹配值，同时分别考虑是否对每一项乘以权重 g(s)；此外，我们还生成了 500 个随机十锚点调度方案。 人工设计的调度方案位于随机调度方案的前 10% 中，但并非代理模型的最优解：无加权最优解接近均匀分布（间隔为 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4），而 g 加权的最佳解则呈现从密集到稀疏的形态（间隔分别为 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5 以及 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 5）。 然而，在端到端评估中，我们的开发集上，在所有其他 FSC-Quality 参数保持固定的情况下，这些方案无一能超越人工设计的调度方案（表 17；图 10(b)），并且代理模型对其可比较的调度方案进行了错误排序（它将均匀分布的方案排在密集到稀疏的方案之前）。 代理模型的最优调度方案运行速度提升了 2.6%；这一延迟差异最多只能解释它们 0.008–0.020 SSIM 差距中的约 0.008 SSIM。 因此，影响曲线表明需要扩大间隔；而锚点位置本身则是通过经验选择的。
